experiment: EXP-034b de-circularized objective skill-matching benchmark (Stage-3 panel fix)
note: Labels are DEFINITIONAL (canonical-catalog + curated non-equivalences); MiniLM is NOT used for any EXACT or hard-negative decision -> no circularity. Embedding SEMANTIC tier is reported by EXP-034 as EXPLORATORY only.
interpretation: Strong, non-circular claims: (1) orthographic/abbreviation/synonym variants are correctly collapsed to EXACT via the catalog; (2) similar-named NON-equivalent technologies are NOT falsely merged (false-exact rate is the key safety metric); (3) misspellings are only partially robust (a known limitation, matches EXP-029). The embedding-based SEMANTIC tier remains exploratory and is not claimed as validated.
